title: SCA Minhag of the Week 308: "Why Tehilim 67 is in the Shape of a Menorah"

chapters.title: Introduction to the Menorah image in our Siddurim
Arrangement in the shape of a Menorah
The source in Abu Darham and the Beit HaMikdash
The proper way to hold and read it upright

summary: Sephardic Community Alliance explains the tradition of reciting Tehilim chapter 67 in the shape of a Menorah before Baruch She'amar. The class discusses the structure of the psalm, its historical background with David HaMelech, and the proper way to hold and read it upright according to our Hakhamim.
questions: Why do we say Tehilim 67 in the shape of a Menorah?
How many words and verses are in Tehilim 67?
Who is the earliest Hakham to discuss reciting this Mizmor?
How should the Menorah text be held and read?
